description: 5G Connectivity for Faster Performance: Experience lightning-fast 5G speeds for seamless streaming, gaming, and browsing without lag. 6.72” 120Hz IPS LCD Display: Enjoy a smooth and immersive visual experience with HDR10 support and 1000 nits peak brightness. 50MP AI Dual Camera System: Capture sharp, detailed images with a 50MP primary sensor and 8MP ultra-wide lens for stunning landscapes and group shots. 16MP Selfie Camera with HDR: Take crystal-clear selfies and record high-quality 1080p videos for social media and video calls. Powerful Unisoc T760 (6nm) Processor: Delivers efficient performance for multitasking, gaming, and everyday use with smooth responsiveness. 4GB RAM + 128GB Storage with Expandable Memory: Enjoy lag-free performance and store more photos, videos, and apps with a dedicated microSDXC slot. Massive 5000mAh Battery & 18W Fast Charging: Stay powered throughout the day with all-day battery life and quick recharging capability.
